text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedure P1, which 
must be performed on an annually bases Y1 or at pump pressure < 90 kg/cm2 
 as indicated in the above 
titled block
This pump supply hydraulic oil for steam valves.
Technical Specifications
Type | Axial piston pump
Bearing Type | Tapered roller bearing P/N 28549
 Needie bearing 
 P/N 28566
Rated Pressure | 210 kg/cm2
Flow 
 rate | 13 g/minute
Temp | 60 C
Pump Speed | 1800 rpm
Horse Power | 15 HP
The first draft is initiated by eng. Mamdoh Anber, tested by eng. Hussien Kamal 
Shaliby at 08 July 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Abouda El Bana, 
accepted by general director eng. Yosry Abd El Maqsood, and approved by eng. 
Mostafa Alam head sector of Talkha Power Station
This document updated by eng. Mahmoud Abou Elfetouh Shata, accepted by 
 general manager eng.
 Mamdoh Anber, approved by eng. Farouk Awad Aly, revised by eng. Abouda El-Bana,
 certified by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel MDEPC inspection and quality 
 control general director & MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. Mohamed 
 Nageb : MDEPC inspection & quality control head sector
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of the pumps motor
The 
 pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves
Be sure 
 pump must be completely drained
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid.
Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly
Check pump pressure value major maintenance (Setting value 112 
 kg/cm2)
Remove pressure compensator cartridge and remove volume limit 
 assembly.
Remove compensator control piston & volume limit control limit.
Remove (8) 3/8" x 31/2" socket head cap screw and remove (8) 
 copper washers
Separate drive cover and port end cover
Lift off drive end cover assembly and remove retaining ring 
 and lift out
Remove (7) pistons and hold down plate
Remove thrust plate
Remove seal retaining ring and remove drive shaft seal
Remove drive shaft retaining ring
Remove the drive shaft from drive cover assembly.
Remove the trnnino nut assembly
Remove the thrust washers
Remove reaction plate
Remove rationing ring
Remove (2) roller bearing and needle bearing.
Remove (7) piston springs from rotor and remove (7) piston 
 seats from rotor.
Remove valve plate from port end cover and remove O-ring from 
 port end cover.
Inspection
Inspect the piston and rotor for wear or damage.
Inspect the end play of ball socket joint in piston and shoe 
 for wear or damage.
Inspect the back side shoe for wear or damage.
Inspect the thrust plate for wear and deformation.
Inspect hold down plate for wear and deformation.
Inspect valve plate for wear and deformation.
Inspect parts of compensatory for wear or damage.
Inspect of tapered roller and needle bearing for damage.
Reassembly
Install (2) roller bearing cups and cones in drive end cover.
Install retaining ring and reaction plate and thrust washers on trunnion.
Install trunnion nut assemblies.
Tighten 2 3/8" trunnion nuts and insert drive shaft to point of inter 
 perence 
 fit.
Install the shaft into the place.
Install bearing retraining ring.
Install shaft seal.
Install thrust plate in reaction plate then install (7) piston and shoe 
 assemblies and hold down plate and hold down plate retaining ring.
Install position of retaining ring and install valve plate.
Install (7) spring seats in bottom of piston bores then install rotor in 
 position on valve plate
Install (7) piston springs in rotor bores and install O-ring
Install drive end sub-assembly to port end sub assembly.
Install (8) 3/8" x 3" socket head cap screw be sure copper washers are under 
 the head of each cap screw.
Install volume limit control piston in 1/2 " control bore install control piston 
 and starter spring in 11/16" control bore.
Install volume limit adjustment parts, and install compensator
Check the direction of pump rotation before starting the pump for the first 
 time.
Check pump pressure after maintenance above (112 Kg/Cm2)
Check the direction of rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first 
 time.
Open the suction and delivery valve.
Check the temperature of the anti-friction bearing in the bearing top.
Check the temperature of cooling water at discharge.
